/scripts.value:
command generateData
	local tList, tFirstName, tLastName, tEmail, tPassword, tOutputA, tDataA
	local tTeacherID, tUserID, tTeacherIDsToSync, tResultA, tClassName, tClassID
	local tClassIDsToSync, tStudentID, tStudentIDsToSync, tRosterIDsToSync
	
	put "password1" into tPassword
	set the randomSeed to char -5 to -1 of the millisecs
	 repeat (numOfTeachers)
		 get random(2)
		 if it = 1 then
			 put maleList into tList
		 else
			 put femaleList into tList
		end if		
		
		 put line random(number of lines of tList) of tList into tFirstName
		 put line random(number of lines of lastList) of lastList into tLastName
		put tFirstName & "." & tLastName & "@demo.com" into tEmail
		cdb_createUserAccount tEmail, tPassword, tFirstName, tLastName, True, False
		
		put empty into tOutputA
		put cdb_readUsersByEmail(tEmail) into tOutputA
		if tOutputA is not empty then
			put tOutputA[tEmail]["cdb"]["cdbRecordID"] into tUserID
			
			if tUserID is not empty then
				put empty into tDataA
				put empty into tTeacherID
				put tEmail into tDataA["email"]
				put tFirstName into tDataA["FirstName"]
				put tLastName into tDataA["LastName"]
				put tUserID into tDataA["TeacherID"]
				put cdb_create(tDataA, "Teachers", "local") into tTeacherID
				
				if tTeacherID is not empty then
					put tTeacherID & lf after tTeacherIDsToSync
					
					repeat (numOfClasses)
						put line random(number of lines of classList) of classList into tClassName
						put " " & random(4) after tClassName
						
						put empty into tDataA
						put empty into tClassID
						put tClassName into tDataA["ClassName"]
						put tUserID into tDataA["TeacherID"]
						put cdb_create(tDataA, "Classes", "local") into tClassID
						
						if tClassID is not empty then
							put empty into tDataA
							put tClassID into tDataA["ClassID"]
							cdb_update tDataA, "Classes", tClassID, "local"
							put tClassID & lf after tClassIDsToSync
							
							repeat (numOfStudents)
								get random(2)
								 if it = 1 then
									 put maleList into tList
								 else
									 put femaleList into tList
								end if		
								
								 put line random(number of lines of tList) of tList into tFirstName
								 put line random(number of lines of lastList) of lastList into tLastName
								put tFirstName & "." & tLastName & "@demo.com" into tEmail
								
								put empty into tDataA
								put empty into tStudentID
								put tEmail into tDataA["email"]
								put tFirstName into tDataA["FirstName"]
								put tLastName into tDataA["LastName"]
								put tClassID into tDataA["ClassID"]
								put cdb_create(tDataA, "Students", "local") into tStudentID
								
								if tStudentID is not empty then
									put empty into tDataA
									put tStudentID into tDataA["StudentID"]
									cdb_update tDataA, "Students", tStudentID, "local"
									put tStudentID & lf after tStudentIDsToSync
									
									put empty into tDataA
									put empty into tRosterID
									put tStudentID into tDataA["StudentID"]
									put tClassID into tDataA["ClassID"]
									put cdb_create(tDataA, "ClassRosters", "local") into tRosterID
									
									if tRosterID is not empty then
										put tRosterID & lf after tRosterIDsToSync
									end if
								end if
							end repeat
						end if
					end repeat
				end if
			end if
		end if
	 end repeat
	delete char -1 of tTeacherIDsToSync
	delete char -1 of tClassIDsToSync
	delete char -1 of tStudentIDsToSync
	delete char -1 of tRosterIDsToSync
	
	if tTeacherIDsToSync is not empty then
		put cdb_sync(tTeacherIDsToSync, "Teachers", "local", True, False) into tResultA
	end if
	if tClassIDsToSync is not empty then
		put cdb_sync(tClassIDsToSync, "Classes", "local", True, False) into tResultA
	end if
	if tStudentIDsToSync is not empty then
		put cdb_sync(tStudentIDsToSync, "Students", "local", True, False) into tResultA
	end if
	if tRosterIDsToSync is not empty then
		put cdb_sync(tRosterIDsToSync, "ClassRosters", "local", True, False) into tResultA
	end if
end generateData
